posts.caption:
No words, just the nod. If you know, you know 😏

ما يحتاج كلام.. هزّة رأس تكفي 😏

analysis.content_type: Behind-the-scenes kitchen team video featuring chefs
analysis.visual_summary: The video frame shows several chefs in a commercial kitchen. A central chef in a black uniform with red trim and a tall white chef hat faces the camera; other chefs are partially visible on either side. A small embroidered logo and Arabic lettering appear on the central chef's uniform.
analysis.caption_summary: The bilingual English and Arabic caption says that a nod is enough and implies an insider understanding of a nonverbal exchange.
evidence: The caption reads, “No words, just the nod. If you know, you know,” followed by the Arabic equivalent.
Multiple people wearing chef uniforms and chef hats are visible in a stainless-steel kitchen setting.
No food, menu, prices, offer details, ordering information, or invitation to take an action are shown.
An embroidered emblem with small Arabic text is visible on the central chef's uniform, though the wording is not clearly legible.

The perfect box for your gatherings — Sharing Box from The Bay.
Available on delivery apps.

analysis.cta_description: The post encourages audiences to get the Sharing Box through the listed delivery apps.
analysis.promotion_description: It promotes The Bay's Sharing Box as a meal for friends' gatherings and family get-togethers, displaying its included dishes and delivery availability.
analysis.content_type: A product-focused delivery promotion for a group meal box.
analysis.text_in_image: بوكس الجمعات / sharing box; The Bay Restaurant; delivery-platform logos: noon Food, Mrsool, Keeta, ToYou, Ninja, Jahez, and HungerStation.
analysis.visual_summary: A branded The Bay food box is shown open against red draped fabric, containing several bowls of rice, chicken dishes, sauces, and samosas. The image labels it as a Sharing Box and shows logos for multiple delivery platforms.
analysis.caption_summary: The Arabic and English caption presents The Bay Sharing Box for friend and family gatherings, lists the box contents—three biryani rice portions, several chicken dishes, and samosas—and states that it is available on delivery apps.
evidence: The caption calls the product the 'Sharing Box from The Bay' and says it is suitable for gatherings.
The caption lists biryani rice, butter chicken, chicken tikka masala, chicken 65, another chicken dish, and samosas as box contents.
The image visibly shows an open box with multiple prepared food portions and samosas.
The image includes The Bay Restaurant logo on the box lid.
The image displays delivery-platform logos, and the caption says 'Available on delivery apps.'
No price or discount amount is shown in the caption or image.

posts.caption:
Nothing makes a chef happier than hearing ‘this is so good’ 🤩
أكثر شي يفرّح الشيف لما يسمع: الأكل رهيب

analysis.content_type: A chef-focused appreciation post portraying the chef’s positive reaction to diners praising the food.
analysis.text_in_image: THE BAY RESTAURANT & LOUNGE; POV: THE CHEF’S SMILE WHEN HE HEARS YOUR TABLE SAY "THIS IS SO GOOD"
analysis.visual_summary: A smiling chef in a chef’s hat and dark uniform is shown in a framed portrait against a wood-paneled background. The Bay Restaurant & Lounge logo appears in the upper-right, and a caption-style message is displayed beneath the portrait.
analysis.caption_summary: In English and Arabic, the caption says that hearing diners say the food is very good makes a chef happiest.
evidence: The image shows one chef smiling while wearing a chef’s hat and uniform.
The caption and image text both center on a diner complimenting the food.
No dish, menu, price, offer, event detail, or ordering/reservation instruction is shown.
The upper-right corner contains The Bay Restaurant & Lounge name and logo.

evidence: The caption explicitly names the dish as “Chicken Jalfrezi.”
The image visibly shows a prepared chicken dish in sauce, garnished with coriander and ginger.
